title: IndexError when calling tokenizer on empty string
body: Calling `tokenizer('')` raises IndexError on line 42 of tokenization_utils.py. Reproducible on transformers==4.35.0.
label: bug

title: Add support for Flash Attention 2 in GPT-NeoX
body: It would be great to add Flash Attention 2 support to GPT-NeoX models for faster inference on A100 GPUs.
label: feature

title: Update README with new pipeline API
body: The README still shows the old `pipeline()` syntax. It should be updated to reflect the new kwargs introduced in 4.30.
label: docs

title: How do I load a model in 8-bit on CPU?
body: I'm trying to use `load_in_8bit=True` but I get an error saying CUDA is not available. How can I load in 8-bit on CPU?
label: question

title: Mismatched tensor sizes in cross-attention
body: Getting RuntimeError: size mismatch in cross-attention layer when using encoder-decoder models with batch size > 1 and different sequence lengths.
label: bug

title: Support GGUF format for local inference
body: Please add native GGUF format support so users don't need llama.cpp as an intermediary.
label: feature

title: Fix typo in configuration docs
body: In the docs for BertConfig, `num_attention_heads` is spelled as `num_attenion_heads` in one example.
label: docs

title: What's the difference between AutoModel and AutoModelForCausalLM?
body: Can someone explain when to use AutoModel vs AutoModelForCausalLM? I'm confused about which to pick.
label: question

title: Memory leak when calling model.generate() in a loop
body: GPU memory grows unboundedly when calling `model.generate()` 1000 times in a loop without clearing the cache.
label: bug

title: Add TensorFlow Lite export support
body: Would be very useful to have a one-line export to TFLite for mobile deployment.
label: feature

title: Incorrect dtype example in quantization guide
body: The quantization guide shows `torch.float16` but should say `torch.bfloat16` for Ampere GPUs.
label: docs

title: How to freeze specific layers during fine-tuning?
body: I want to freeze layers 0-5 and only train layers 6-11 plus the classification head. What's the recommended way?
label: question

title: Trainer ignores custom DataCollator when using DeepSpeed
body: When `deepspeed` config is set, the Trainer silently falls back to DefaultDataCollator, ignoring my custom one.
label: bug

title: Expose temperature in pipeline for text-generation
body: The `text-generation` pipeline doesn't expose a `temperature` parameter directly. Please add it.
label: feature

title: Broken link to paper in model card for BERT
body: The arxiv link in the BERT model card 404s. It should point to https://arxiv.org/abs/1810.04805.
label: docs

title: Does Trainer support gradient checkpointing with FSDP?
body: I'm trying to combine FSDP and gradient checkpointing. Is this supported? I couldn't find it in the docs.
label: question

title: OOM error when tokenizing dataset with map() on large corpus
body: Using `dataset.map(tokenize_fn, batched=True)` on a 50GB dataset causes OOM even with `batch_size=32`.
label: bug

title: Add INT4 quantization via bitsandbytes
body: INT4 quantization is much more memory-efficient than INT8. Please add `load_in_4bit` support.
label: feature

title: Update migration guide for 5.0 breaking changes
body: The migration guide doesn't mention the removal of `use_auth_token` parameter. Many users are confused.
label: docs

title: How to save only the LoRA weights after fine-tuning?
body: After fine-tuning with LoRA, I want to save only the adapter weights, not the full model. How?
label: question

title: Wrong attention mask shape when using left-padding
body: When `padding_side='left'` and batch size > 1, the attention mask has incorrect shape causing generation to hallucinate.
label: bug

title: Add streaming output for pipeline text-generation
body: The text-generation pipeline blocks until generation is complete. A streaming callback or iterator would make interactive UX possible.
label: feature

title: AutoTokenizer docs missing fast vs slow comparison table
body: The AutoTokenizer page mentions fast and slow tokenizers but has no comparison table for speed or feature differences.
label: docs

title: Is there a way to get token log-probabilities from pipeline?
body: I need per-token log-probabilities for scoring. The pipeline API doesn't seem to expose them. Is there a supported way?
label: question

title: Pipeline crashes on MPS device with batch_size > 1
body: On Apple Silicon with `device='mps'`, the text-classification pipeline raises RuntimeError on any batch size greater than 1. Works fine on CPU.
label: bug
